children: may stabilise around a support at $80.47 per barrel and retest a resistance at $82.39.
The contract managed to hover above a key support at $79.28, the 161.8% projection level of a downtrend from $87.42. The stabilisation indicates a completion of a three-wave cycle from $89.49.
The market may bounce towards the peak of the wave b around $84.91. A break below $80.47 could trigger a drop into the $79.28-$79.88 range.
On the daily chart, a bearish target zone of $77.04-$78.18 has been temporarily aborted. It will be resumed when the market falls below the previous trading session's low of $79.07.
A piercing pattern formed on Tuesday, suggesting a bounce or a pullback towards the $$83.41-$84.35 range.
